Portal 2 BETA Launcher may use 7-Zip command-line tools for archive handling. The source package reserves bin/3RD-Party-Tools/7-Zip/ but does not bundle 7-Zip binaries in this source package.

7-Zip is a separate third-party project. Keep the complete license and notice files that ship with the exact 7-Zip build distributed with a release. Different 7-Zip versions may include different components and license notices.
